Hi Lucas — thanks for the clear ask and the manifest.

Short answers up front: yes, we can take the lead on the publisher claim orchestration and we have a staging checklist that reduces back-and-forth with the portal. I've attached a one-page runbook (publisher-claim-runbook-draft.md) that spells the steps we can operate as a partner-run flow.

Key notes from our side:
- We can open the publisher claim on Contoso's behalf if Contoso delegates the tenant owner via the Azure portal (minimal one-time consent).
- For staging, we recommend: 1) manifest validation in our sandbox, 2) SKU and metering sanity checks, 3) a quick smoke deploy behind our test subscription to verify image/VM/container boot and API egress rules.
- Co-sell: populate co-sell ID, business contact, and the first-line ISV support contact in the offer metadata to avoid manual gating.

Would you be available for a 30-min sync today or tomorrow so Karthik (tech lead) can walk through the checklist? If you prefer, we can start async by me flagging the manifest errors we see.

Next steps I propose:
1) I validate the attached manifest and send a short list of required manifest edits (by EOD).
2) Karthik runs the sandbox deploy & SKU test (T+1).
3) Marissa coordinates any minimal contract/DocuSign items needed for co-sell enablement (she's looped).

Ping me what works for you.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference

--

Thanks — I took a pass on the manifest in the zip. Quick technical observations:

- The schema is OK but SKU IDs contain upper-case characters; portal validation is strict (lowercase and hyphen only). I'll attach a minimal diff in a follow-up.
- Metering dimensions missing for the streaming SKU. We'll need a simple metrics.json and a sample usage meter definition.
- Offer landing page references a private S3 bucket URL for assets. For Azure staging we'll need assets in a public storage account (signed URL can work for staging but recommend blob storage with temporary SAS).

Action items from engineering:
- Lucas: If you can re-export manifest with lowercase SKU IDs we can fast-track validation.
- Karthik: I will run the sandbox deploy once we have an updated package.

If helpful I can walk through the SKU changes in a quick 20-min call.

On the co-sell metadata: include a primary sales contact (name/email) and the MPN ID in the publisher profile to avoid manual queueing.

-Karthik
Tech Integrations, Redwood Inference
